name: Crunchyroll
notes: Burnt-orange base with a single speed bar on the right edge and a corner wedge bottom-left, suggesting motion without any play glyph.

name: Amazon Music
notes: Deep teal-navy with two mirrored equaliser silhouettes on opposite corners; the sound-wave bars carry the music idea and stay off the centre band.

name: Spotify - Music and Podcasts
notes: Near-black forest base with two thin rays fanning from the top-right corner in a vivid green that is brighter than the muted Hulu and Xbox greens.

name: Tubi
notes: Near-black base with a faint warm cast and two longer lemon slabs at the bottom-left, so the yellow reads as the only colour on the card.

name: Freevee
notes: Plum base with two quarter-ring arcs in opposite corners, a free-to-air ripple idea in magenta that is unlike any other card's hue.

name: AMC+
notes: Graphite base with three slanted silver stripes along the top edge, a clapperboard cue in a neutral, cinematic palette that stays out of the hue families.

name: Angel Studios
notes: Wine-plum base with a soft beam of light falling from top centre and a champagne ray in the bottom-right corner; the light motif suggests a warm, uplifting tone.

name: ESPN
notes: Charcoal base with a scarlet slab on the bottom-right and a darker one top-left; the coral-tinted wordmark keeps it apart from the pure-red Netflix and YouTube cards.

name: Sling TV
notes: Midnight-cobalt base with an orange pillar on the left edge and a blue wedge top-right; the orange TV accent echoes the brand's warm colour without copying its mark.
